# @arki/resilience

> Retry, circuit breaker, timeout, bulkhead and curated presets, with a shared `backoff` schedule and typed errors. It is not a job queue and not a cross-process rate limiter.

An expected outcome is a returned failure, not a throw. Bound every retry with `.upTo(n)`.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/resilience`: retry, circuit breaker, timeout, bulkhead and curated presets, with typed errors and a `backoff` schedule shared with `@arki/queue` and `@arki/journal`. `BulkheadRejectedError`, `Cancelled`, `CancelledError`, `CircuitOpenError`, `InvalidBackoffError`, `RESILIENCE_ERROR_CODES`, `RETRY_FAILURES`, `RETRY_WAIT_FAILURES`, `ResilienceError`, `RetriesExhaustedError`, `TimeoutError`, `attachPolicyLogger`; and 49 more.
- `@arki/resilience/dot`: `RESILIENCE_PLUGIN_ERROR_CODES`, `resilience`; types `ResilienceService`.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Rules that bite

- A returned failure is not retried unless `.while(Definition)` names it.
- A thrown error is retried, then thrown again unchanged.
- No `.upTo(n)` means retry forever.
- A cancel is never retried and never mapped.
- A policy with a fallback or `onThrow` cannot go inside `wrap`.
